items.name: SqliteDialect
items.doc:
The SQLite dialect (database.sqlite): moves to zell-lang/sqlite with the
driver (docs/EXTRACTION.md). Placeholders are ?, an OFFSET without a
limit needs LIMIT -1, strings use instr/substr, migrations use SQLite
types (INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT keys) and comment out the
ALTER TABLE forms SQLite lacks. PostgreSQL-only calls (data_postgres.zl)
are not translated here: they fail with "... is not supported by sqlite".
items.summary: The SQLite dialect (database.sqlite): moves to zell-lang/sqlite with the driver (docs/EXTRACTION.md).
